title: Reinforcement Learning for Optimal Sensor Placement in Water Distribution Networks: Systematic Literature Review — Supporting Evidence and Reproducibility Materials
description: Supporting research materials for a systematic literature review of reinforcement learning approaches to sensor placement in water distribution networks. The deposit includes review methods and PICOS eligibility criteria, database-specific search strategies, Covidence import provenance, PRISMA flow counts, the included-study register, recovered full-text exclusion records, data-extraction records, evidence-gap reconciliation, descriptive methodological appraisal, and supplementary figures. The complete decision-level export for all 377 title/abstract records was not recovered and this limitation is documented. Screening and extraction were conducted by one reviewer. The journal-submission manuscript and publisher-formatted full-text articles are intentionally excluded.
